US To Sell $115 Bln In Reopened 4-Week Bills Thu
WASHINGTON (Dow Jones)--The U.S. Treasury plans to auction $115 billion in reopened 4-week bills Thursday.
The debt will settle on Nov. 10, 2026 and will mature Dec. 08, 2026.
The debt is a reopening of an issue first sold on Aug. 11, 2026.
The Federal Reserve holds $21.64 billion of maturing securities for its own account. Amounts bid by the Federal Reserve banks for their own account will be in addition to the public offering amount.

Noncompetitive tenders for the 4-week bills, available in minimum denominations of $100, must be received by 11:00 AM Eastern Time Thursday. Competitive tenders available in minimum denominations of $100, must be received by 11:30 AM Eastern Time.
(Data provided by the U.S. Treasury Dept.)
